spans.text: Law 4: Attribute Safety. ``>`` inside a prop value is FATAL. Escape `"` inside props with `\"`. All props must be quoted strings. BANNED in props: `{{...}}`, `{[...]}`, `{...}`, JSON objects, Markdown formatting.
spans.note: Enforces input validation and sanitization rules for component props, preventing injection-style attacks through prop values. Directly aligns with D4's validate-first principle.

spans.text: Law 7: XML-Safe Text. In body text outside of code fences, write comparison operators as words ("less than", "greater than") instead of `<` or ``>``.
spans.note: Prevents unsafe characters from being interpreted as XML/markup tags, protecting output integrity and avoiding unintended code execution or parsing errors.
